# Sabay Shop

> Cambodia's #1 online marketplace to buy and sell new and second-hand products — electronics, vehicles, fashion, home goods and more.

## Marketplace

- [Home](https://sabay-shop-web.vercel.app/): browse featured listings and categories
- [All products](https://sabay-shop-web.vercel.app/products): search and filter every listing
- [Sell an item](https://sabay-shop-web.vercel.app/create-product): publish a new listing

## Company

- [Help & Support](https://sabay-shop-web.vercel.app/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://sabay-shop-web.vercel.app/)
- [Terms & Conditions](https://sabay-shop-web.vercel.app/)

## API

- [Public API](https://sabay-shop-api.onrender.com/api): JSON REST API used by the storefront
